scope: Read-only primary-source gesture research; original adaptation for a SwiftKey helper, not a copy or runtime/device validation of the reference applications.

sources.finding: Uses angular sectors and nearest available secondary-key selection after a movement threshold.
ACTION_UP sends pointer identity rather than its endpoint coordinates to onTouchUp; MOVE updates direction selection.
The archived GitHub recognizer tracks the farthest displacement and releases the selected gesture on pointer-up; dragging follows a distance threshold.

reference_limitations: FlickBoard reference is the archived 2024 GitHub snapshot, not a claim about its current Codeberg version.
Other per-key gesture keyboards do not establish compatibility with SwiftKey Japanese glide. Global farthest-point locking and unconditional ignoring of UP coordinates are not adopted.

adaptation.minimum_distance: Euclidean distance using the existing key-relative minimum; removes extra distance required solely by a diagonal direction.
adaptation.direction_gate: Delay direction rejection within the larger of minimum distance and bounded Android touch tolerance.
adaptation.release_tolerance: Only the immediately preceding eligible accepted sample, with a bounded endpoint displacement; no recovery of earlier rejected paths or full return to origin.
adaptation.kept: Native UP-only commit, popup/editor/pointer restrictions, prior up-distance ceiling and bounded down/reverse tolerance.

evidence_limits: Chosen 60/65-degree angles and 500ms ceiling are local design choices, not claimed constants or standards shared by the reference apps. Physical-device feel and native-engine behavior remain unverified.
